title: Google Hotels Scraper
description: Collect hotel listings from Google Hotels by URL or keyword. Prices, ratings, reviews, images, deal labels, and booking links are read from Google's result data.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Google Hotels search URL. Used when no keyword is supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search text such as "hotels in Paris". Takes precedence over startUrl when supplied.

results_wanted.title: Results Wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of hotel listings to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum Pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of Google result pages to request. In testing, broad city searches returned 48 to 70 unique hotels.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy is off by default. Turn it on or add custom proxy URLs if Google blocks your runs.
